title: Chris Urmson: How a driverless car sees the road
summary: Chris Urmson, head of Google's self-driving car program, shows footage of how the car perceives the road and decides what to do. Examples include cyclist hand signals, school buses, police officers and complex intersections.
why: Used repeatedly in self-driving threads as a demonstration of how many real-world edge cases the Google/Waymo system already handled.

quote.text: This video shows why staying in your lane on a highway (what Tesla autopilot does) and dealing with city streets are two just completely different things
